purpose: Graph-of-Mark semantic refinement for PSD-to-UIIR component grouping.
rules: Treat PSD layer hierarchy, ui_graph.json edges, and graph_overlay.png ids as primary grounding evidence.
Confirm or reject relation edges instead of regenerating the entire UI tree.
Do not invent or edit final pixel coordinates.
Do not output XML or Screen nodes.
Use component_group_id only when graph evidence supports a runtime component wrapper.
Use parent_candidate_id only when it references a supplied candidate id or layer ref.
Keep Text candidates as Text unless the local metadata proves they are not text.
Do not downgrade a concrete local type to Unknown.
For repeated_pattern edges, prefer List/Grid only when items are visually repeated and semantically related.
Return relation_patches, component_group_patches, role/layout patches, and render_diff_notes as structured JSON.
